# UX & Accessibility Requirements Checklist: Owners Header Navigation

**Purpose**: Validate that the navigation/menu requirements (FR-001–FR-006, Scenarios 1–5, Edge
Cases) are complete, unambiguous, consistent, and testable before `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-10-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark
an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for dismissing the open "Owners" menu via an outside click, not just Escape? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for what the menu does if the user re-selects "Add new" while already on `/owners/new` (does it close, stay open, re-navigate)? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are accessible-name requirements specified separately for the menu trigger and for the "Add new" item, rather than only for "the Owners entry" as a whole? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the "active/highlighted state" in Scenario 5 defined with a specific, verifiable visual and/or semantic criterion (e.g., a named style, `aria-current`), or left open to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §Scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "narrow/mobile viewports" in the Edge Cases quantified with a breakpoint or width range, or left ambiguous for whoever implements the responsive check? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Does SC-001's "2 interactions or fewer" define what counts as one interaction (e.g., does opening the menu count separately from selecting "Add new")? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do FR-002 (menu/dropdown trigger) and Acceptance Scenario 1 ("an Owners navigation entry… distinct from Home") agree on whether "Owners" itself navigates anywhere, or is purely a trigger with no destination of its own? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 / Scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the keyboard-interaction requirements in FR-005 (open/arrow-navigate/dismiss) stated to apply uniformly across desktop and the narrow-viewport case in Edge Cases, or could they diverge? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005 / Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Is SC-002 ("100% of pages… continue to expose the path") objectively verifiable given the spec does not enumerate the full set of pages that render the shared header? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Does SC-003's "fails if the header entry is removed or mislabeled" specify what exact label/accessible name a test should assert on, or is "mislabeled" left to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are Alternate flows addressed — reaching and activating the menu via keyboard-only interaction, not just pointer? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Are Exception/failure flows addressed, e.g., what the menu or page should communicate if navigating to `/owners/new` fails to load? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for keyboard focus placement after the menu closes (after Escape vs. after selecting "Add new")? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Does the narrow-viewport requirement specify pass/fail criteria beyond "remains reachable" (e.g., fully visible on-screen without manual scrolling)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the `/owners/[id]` header requirements explicitly confirmed to match the home-page header requirements (same active-state logic), or could an implementer reasonably compute active state differently per route? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Is there a requirement for how "Owners" should render before client-side interactivity (hydration) completes, given the menu depends on client-side state? [Gap, Ambiguity]

## Non-Functional Requirements (Accessibility)

- [ ] CHK017 Are screen-reader announcement requirements defined for the menu's open/close state transition? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the specific ARIA roles/attributes expected on the trigger and menu items stated as requirements, or left entirely to implementation choice? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK019 Is the assumption that "Home" stays unchanged validated against its current exact label and position in the header, so "additive" is unambiguous? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Is FR-003's dependency on `/owners/new`'s existing, unaltered behavior explicitly traceable to the `001-register-owner` spec it originates from? [Traceability, Spec §FR-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
